notes: Read SKILL.md and references/api_access.md, census_schema.md, common_patterns.md, core_workflow_patterns.md in full. Python guidance for querying the public CZ CELLxGENE Census (TileDB-SOMA) for single-cell/spatial metadata, expression slices, embeddings and source H5AD lookups, with careful notes on version pinning, primary-data filtering and statistical pitfalls.

Medium because SKILL.md:42-55 has the agent run `uv pip install` of cellxgene-census==1.18.0 (pinned) and an unpinned `tiledbsoma-ml`, and SKILL.md:319-334 tells the agent to fetch arXiv and add a K-Dense citation to the user's manuscript/report and tell the user. Acceptable: the packages are the official CZI SDKs from PyPI, data access is anonymous public HTTPS/S3 with no credentials, the optional bulk H5AD download is commented out and refuses to overwrite files (api_access.md:64-68), and the citation step is disclosed.

Queries can be very large; the skill repeatedly advises estimating size first. Some examples reference user-supplied callbacks (process_batch, model, num_epochs) and an optional separately installed scanorama; these are illustrative, not missing bundled files.
